raw.title: Implementation Analyst
raw.description:
Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients in the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Implementation Analyst

We take customer onboarding very seriously - we’re known for a ‘right first time’ approach when we set up in a practice and as an Implementation Analyst, you will have a huge impact in scaling Scribe usage and adoption across the NHS. Our products are designed for ease of use across the healthcare space, so ensuring our end users feel confident is essential - this is where you come in.

  • Running training sessions for our users on Accurx products: this could be online or in person in NHS settings across the UK, covering between 30-300 people per session

  • Demo-ing the full functionality of Accurx products: our products are updated regularly, so ensuring you’re fully up to speed on what’s new and what’s coming for our users is essential

  • Designing, building and testing new training content: you’ll get to deliver content how you want to and try new things

  • Using data, automation & AI to improve: we’re working on becoming truly AI native in 2026 and beyond, and we’re looking to adopt new practices to bring in automation and AI to make the lives of us and our end users even easier

You should apply if...

  • You’re an engaging and captivating trainer

  • User and customer experience is a top priority to you

  • You pride yourself on building genuine relationships and partnerships

  • When you spot something not working, you're quick to raise the issue and be part of the solution

  • Versatility is your strong suit - you can work independently or as part of a team

  • You’ve used data, automation and AI to make life easier, either in your professional or personal life

  • You have a passion for healthcare, Tech for Good or the NHS - we can teach you what you need to know, but you have to be passionate about our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Fix Healthcare Communication

  • £32,000 - £45,000 salary + share options up to £7,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible Working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am-4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.
Find us across social media: Medium, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube.

Compensation: £32K – £45K • Offers Equity

Role Description

This is a full-ownership product role at the centre of one of Allica's most effective growth channels. Accountants already introduce established SMEs to Allica and are often the first port of call when those clients make financial decisions. You will be responsible for turning that relationship into a product experience that drives more recommendations, retention and product depth across their client base. You will define and deliver Allica's proposition for accountants: a product that must feel trustworthy, work flawlessly across a portfolio of client accounts, and set the standard for how Allica builds propositions for the specific people and partners around our SME customers.

You will own the full product lifecycle: setting strategy, shaping the roadmap, leading your squad, and being accountable for commercial outcomes. You will work with a deep understanding of how accountants operate, such as day-to-day reconciliation, VAT and payroll processing, and cash flow advisory across a portfolio of clients, and bring that expertise to bear on a product that is both ambitious and grounded in what accountants and their SME clients actually need.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy, vision, roadmap and execution for Allica's accountants proposition

  • Lead a cross-functional squad (Engineering, Design, Data and Operations) to deliver high-quality customer-facing product features

  • Take full commercial accountability for your squad's OKRs — including accountant-driven customer acquisition, growth, retention, and product depth across accountant-connected SMEs

  • Define and implement the accountant access model, from read-only visibility into client accounts toward richer permissions and access controls

  • Define and deliver the accountant-facing product experience — a multi-client experience and workflow tools that help accountants monitor, reconcile and advise across their portfolio of SME clients

  • Partner with Design, UX and Research to use customer discovery, prototyping and iterative research with both accountants and their SME clients to validate what to build next

  • Define metrics, track outcomes, and anchor all decisions in data — building a culture of evidence-based product development within the squad

  • Identify and manage product, regulatory, and delivery risks proactively, working closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure the product meets all relevant obligations

  • Maintain a clear and well-communicated roadmap, providing regular updates to the Tribe Lead, wider squads and leadership

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Experience taking a product from early MVP to a fully-fledged proposition, ideally within banking, fintech or professional services software

  • Strong commercial acumen — comfortable owning OKRs and making data-driven prioritisation decisions

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently across technical, commercial and regulatory audiences

  • Decisive, with a track record of moving quickly while maintaining quality and managing risk appropriately

  • Experience working in agile squads with Engineers, Designers, Data Analysts and Operations

The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

About the role

This is an existing role within our team. As a Senior Animator, you'll be a key creative force in breathing life, weight, and personality into complex three-dimensional characters and photorealistic creatures. You’ll jump straight into the heart of our storytelling, crafting everything from nuanced, emotional facial expressions to epic, high-action combat performances. If you have a passion for mastering complex anatomy and love the challenge of making mythical beasts—whether they walk, fly, or breathe fire—feel completely grounded in reality, this is the place to do it.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate closely with your Animation Lead and Supervisor to produce premium, story-driven animation that elevates the pacing and style of the film.

  • Partner with our Rigging and Pipeline teams, sharing direct feedback to refine character setups, enhance visual quality, and build smoother tool workflows.

  • Animate both primary and secondary characters, ensuring every element in the frame possesses authentic motion and soul.

  • Take ownership of your workflow, keeping production schedules transparent and hitting your deadlines consistently.

  • Mentor and support less senior artists, sharing your craft and helping them grow their skills.

  • Actively tackle creative changes and follow through constructively on supervisor notes and technical feedback.


  • Significant experience animating on large-scale, photorealistic VFX projects, with a showreel that highlights exceptional creature and character performances.

  • Deep production knowledge of Maya.

  • A natural grasp of physical motion, weight, balance, and spatial awareness.

  • A strong foundation in human and animal anatomy, which underpins how you animate complex fantasy muscle structures and locomotion.

  • An understanding of character rigs, animation pipelines, and data transfer between production tools.

  • Clear, constructive communication and a genuinely collaborative approach to working across distributed pipeline teams.

  • Adaptability, an open mind for direction, and a calm, reliable focus when deadlines approach.

You might also have

  • Experience working with, clean-up, or editing of motion capture data.

  • A traditional background in sketching, life drawing, or classic 2D animation.

  • A working knowledge of Modelling or basic scripting (Python/MEL) to streamline workflows.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

This is a new, hands-on role within our team. You’ll play a vital part in building the future of our cloud-first and machine learning strategies, writing the core software and automation that drives them. In this role, you will be actively developing high-availability automation workflows and building resilient big data pipelines that scale compute across the business. You will provide cloud and systems support for developers building complex agentic applications, while driving DevOps best practices to ensure our cloud services are built for the future.

You'll drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure by designing and implementing automation solutions that scale across the organisation. Your work will span cloud-native practices, machine learning infrastructure, and intelligent systems that keep our environment secure, resilient, and cost-effective.

  • Design and implement event-driven automation and self-healing cloud systems that proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate infrastructure anomalies

  • Architect robust cloud security frameworks, identity management, and automated governance baselines across our global footprint

  • Design and optimise big data infrastructure for handling large metadata datasets and media assets, whilst identifying opportunities to reduce infrastructure spend without compromising performance

  • Experience supporting engineering teams, championing DevSecOps best practices, and collaborating with tech leadership

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between infrastructure engineering and development team workflows

Nice-to-have Skills:

  • Knowledge of virtualisation of service applications

Hi, I'm Tom Clark - CIO, CISO, and hx employee #9. I'm the executive in charge of our Systems & Security function. I joined in 2020 at seed stage, and I've been here through Series A, Series B, and everything in between - watching us grow from nine people to more than 250. I’m six years in, and I've never been more excited about what's ahead.

Fun fact: I didn't come from insurance. I came from TV and media - if you've ever used BBC iPlayer, ITVX, or listened to Capital Radio, I helped make them. I ended up in insurance and became, perhaps unexpectedly, one of the industry's biggest cheerleaders.

I know what you're thinking: insurance isn't cool. I can change your mind in five minutes, or your money back. And the best bit? What we're building with hxOS is cooler still. We take a product-centric, customer-centric view to internal IT - the same rigour and craft you'd bring to any customer-facing product. That's what makes this role different, and it's what I'm most excited about.

Let’s speak soon.
- TC

 

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are decisions that shape real-world outcomes - whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 60 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do: from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

About the SYSSEC team

hxOS is hx's internal operating system. It's the platform every person in the company uses and builds on: devices, meeting rooms, core applications, SSO, AI tools, data infrastructure, security and compliance. The Systems & Security (SYSSEC) team builds it, runs it, and keeps improving it. It'll never be finished. That's the point.

hxOS is as much a vision as a current reality. The foundations are solid, day to day runs well because it has to, nothing gets built on shaky ground. The more ambitious layers - federated, AI-native, product-led infrastructure that the whole business builds on - are what the team is building now.

About the role

The Systems Associate is one of the most visible faces of SYSSEC. They're the first point of contact for everything coming into the team, and the work ranges widely: a day might move from troubleshooting a device, to helping a team get more out of a new AI integration, to contributing to a piece of infrastructure the whole company will rely on. raw.description:
Special Projects

London (Shoreditch) | In person | Full time

About Seamflow

We're removing one of the last great barriers to progress in the physical world. While software moves fast, industries like healthcare, aerospace, and energy are still slowed by outdated, manual systems.

Our vision is to unlock enormous value for Testing, Inspection, and Certification companies globally. The market is vast, the problem is real, and we're just getting started.

We're rapidly growing following our 14x oversubscribed seed round backed by Tier 1 investors including Northzone and Initialized Capital. These funds backed the founders of Coinbase, Reddit, Klarna, and Spotify.

We're growing very fast; demand is outstripping our supply, and we're building fast to keep up.

The Team

Our team includes AI researchers from world-leading academic institutions like Johns Hopkins, MIPT, Oxford, Cambridge and UCL, former founding engineers at unicorn startups, and alumni of X, Google, Amazon, and Yandex, alongside former leaders from McKinsey, BCG and Bain. We look for people who move fast, think clearly, and hold themselves to a high bar. The standard here is very high, and we're looking for someone who raises it further.

The Role

Special Projects sits directly alongside the CEO and Chief of Staff and takes on whatever the company needs most at that moment. There is no fixed remit and there is no playbook.

One month that means preparing the material and the numbers behind a fundraise. The next it's working through legal, regulatory, and market access questions in a country we're entering, or holding an entire function open on your own until we've hired someone permanent into it. Whatever is broken, missing, or unowned lands here first.

Be clear eyed about what this is. It is demanding, and a lot of it is unglamorous. Some of it is detail work that simply has to be right, with nobody available to check it behind you. What we need is a workhorse who is obsessive about detail, who closes things out rather than hands them back, and whose work nobody ever has to second guess. If that reads as a description of you rather than a warning, this is the highest leverage seat in the company for someone early in their career. You will be in the room for decisions most people see five years later.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years in an environment with a high bar and short feedback loops: investment banking, strategy consulting, a fast growing startup, or something equally demanding we haven't thought of.

An exceptional track record: We care that you were at the top of whatever room you were in, academically and professionally.

AI-native: You already run your work through AI and operate at 10x as a result. You reach for these tools by default, not as a novelty, and you're constantly finding new ways to compress what used to take days into hours.

Structured thinking: You break messy, ambiguous problems into parts, work out what actually matters, and sequence it. You can explain your reasoning on a whiteboard in two minutes.

Ruthless organisation: Multiple workstreams, nothing dropped, nothing chased twice, everything written down.

Strong with Excel, slides, and written communication: Most of our work travels as documents and models read by executives at large regulated businesses.

Bias to action: You'd rather ship a good plan today than a perfect one next week.

Work nobody has to check: You close the loop, catch your own mistakes, and flag the things you couldn't resolve rather than leaving them to be discovered.

Low ego, high agency: The work ranges from a board memo to cleaning a customer data set at 9pm. Neither is beneath you, and you'll take on the boring half as readily as the interesting half.

Someone who wants to be in the room, not on a call. This role is in-person, full time at our Shoreditch office.

Nice to have: European languages, particularly German or French.

What You'll Get

A huge amount of responsibility and trust from day one, and direct exposure to every decision that shapes the company

A front row seat to enterprise sales, product, fundraising, and operations, and a real say in all of them

A clear path into an operating or commercial leadership role as we scale or insight into how to start your own tech company some day

A team that moves fast, works hard, and backs each other fully

Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access

raw.title: Fullstack Engineer - Subscriptions
raw.description:
The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners.

Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services.

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale.


What You'll Do

  • Build end-to-end features across modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms that support Spotify's global subscription business.

  • Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that power subscriptions, prepaid products, pricing, promotions, and the offer lifecycle.

  • Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services.

  • Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL.

  • Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability.

  • Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium.


    • Who You Are

  • You have experience building and delivering production software across both frontend and backend technologies.

  • You have experience developing scalable backend services using modern Java, with Java 17+ experience being a plus.

  • You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

  • You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications.

  • You have worked with gRPC services and Protocol Buffers, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in distributed systems.

  • You have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization.

  • You care about writing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software that delivers long-term value.

  • You enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes.

  • You have a passion for simplifying complex workflows and creating intuitive experiences for internal users.

  • Experience with tools such as jOOQ, Flyway, Apollo GraphQL, DataLoader, Styled Components, Storybook, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar technologies will help you ramp up quickly.

  • Experience building commerce platforms, subscription products, pricing systems, distributed systems, or large-scale platform modernization initiatives is beneficial.


    • Where You'll Be

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location.

  • This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zones for collaboration.

    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
     
    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

raw.description:
Commercial Account Executive (DACH/Nordics/CEE)

Location: London, UK

About AppViewX:

AppViewX is trusted by the world's leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform, which is the industry's most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.

Values

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together. 

  • We Do What We Say: We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity. 
  • We Are Trusted Experts: We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need. 
  • We Raise the Bar: We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results. 
  • We Win Together: We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates. 

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX. 

Role Overview

The Commercial Sales Executive is responsible for driving revenue growth, identifying new market opportunities, and managing the entire sales cycle for our products/services across designated territories. This role requires a highly motivated, results-orientated professional with a deep understanding of international business and complex commercial negotiations. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who can operate independently in diverse, fast-paced international markets.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Business Development

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve and exceed sales targets and expand the company's customer base.
  • Identify and qualify new commercial opportunities through market research, networking, and cold outreach in various international markets.
  • Manage the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, presentation, proposal generation, negotiation, and contract closure with customers, distributors, and partners.
  • Focus on generating significant pipeline and growth. 

Market and Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients.
  • Gather market intelligence on industry trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes to inform product development and sales strategy.
  • Represent the company at industry events and conferences.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to localize sales materials and campaigns.

Sales Operations and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales forecasts and activity reports using the company's CRM system.
  • Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews to senior management, outlining regional performance, challenges, and future strategy.
  • Ensure compliance with all international trade regulations and company policies.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of progressive commercial sales experience
  • Demonstrated ability to close complex, high-value commercial deals in a diverse geographical territory.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in German and English.
  • Willingness to travel internationally frequently (up to 50% of the time).

Preferred

  • Experience with a global distribution network or channel partner model.
  • Proven track record of managing and expanding sales into new, emerging markets.

Travel Requirements

  • Travelling to customers, partners and events as and when required.

📍 London (Hybrid — 2 days onsite)

🕒 Permanent | Start ASAP

We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

Operations at Duffel

Duffel's Operations team keeps travel moving after the booking is made. The team is organised into three functions — Travel Ops, Agency Ops, and Product Ops — each owning a distinct part of the post-booking and back-office lifecycle. Agency Ops sits at the financial and reconciliation heart of the business: the team manages ADM (Agent Debit Memo) investigation and dispute resolution with airlines, day-to-day supplier reconciliation across multiple payment rails and currencies, leakage management, fraud investigation, ARC errors, and United check refunds. It's a small, senior-led team — a Senior Agency Ops Consultant, an Agency Ops Consultant, and a BPO-staffed extension — that keeps Duffel's supplier accounts accurate and airline disputes resolved on time.

The Role

We're looking for an Agency Ops Consultant to join our Agency Ops team, reporting to the Senior Agency Ops Consultant. You'll own the day-to-day processing of ADM investigations, supplier reconciliations, and United check refunds across Duffel's supplier accounts — working across multiple currencies and systems to keep our financial records accurate and airline disputes moving to on-time resolution. This is a detail-oriented, process-driven role at the centre of how Duffel manages its supplier relationships and financial exposure.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Receive, analyse, and process incoming ADMs (Agent Debit Memos) from airlines, tracking each through to on-time resolution.

  • Perform day-to-day supplier reconciliations across VCC, ARC, BSP, and additional sources, including multi-currency (USD/EUR/GBP/AUD) transactions.

  • Resolve ARC-specific errors and discrepancies.

  • Process and reconcile refund requests that are irregular.

  • Maintain accurate Chargeback/Fraud and reconciliation records and supporting documentation.

  • Support with onboarding BPO agents and supporting with queries.

What we're looking for:

  • Experience in reconciliation, accounts, or back-office airline operations.

  • GDS Experience

  • Comfortable working across multiple currencies and supplier systems.

  • Strong attention to detail and record-keeping.

  • Confident coordinating directly with airlines and internal stakeholders to move disputes to resolution.

  • Organised and process-driven, comfortable owning documentation and audit trails for reconciliation work.

What you'll be working on (optional)

  • Reconciliation across VCC, ARC, BSP, Supplier Accounts, etc

  • ADM (Agent Debit Memo) dispute cases from initial receipt through to airline resolution.

  • Multi-currency transactions across USD, EUR, GBP, and AUD.

  • ARC-specific error investigation and resolution.

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

Perks That Actually Matter:

✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.

🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy.

⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings.

🏡 Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day.

📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme.

🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans.

The Details

📍 Location: Shoreditch, London (Hybrid: In-office Tuesdays & Thursdays).

🧠 Interview Process: Simple & transparent: (change accordingly to role)

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Hiring Manager Chat

  3. Technical Case Study

  4. Final Stage Interview.

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

raw.description:
📍 London (Hybrid — 2 days onsite)

🕒 Permanent | Start ASAP

 

We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel

About the role

As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.

You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.

You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows.

  • Own support quality. Establish standards for technical investigation, written communication, case ownership and follow-through. Ensure customers understand what is happening, what comes next and who is responsible.

  • Build a dependable support operation. Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team.

  • Strengthen technical capability. Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues.

  • Lead significant customer escalations. Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk.

  • Make collaboration effective. Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs.

  • Improve the product through support. Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction.

  • Make support easier to deliver. Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help.

  • Use evidence to guide decisions. Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience managing and developing a technical support or support engineering team serving business customers.

  • A track record of improving both customer outcomes and how a support function operates.

  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks and integrations, with enough practical depth to guide investigations and earn the trust of engineers.

  • Comfort working with logs, SQL and scripts to investigate problems or improve support workflows.

  • Experience handling consequential customer escalations, including situations where the cause or resolution is initially uncertain.

  • Ability to explain technical issues to developers, business stakeholders and senior leaders.

  • Sound judgement about urgency, customer impact and competing priorities.

  • Evidence of effective hiring, coaching, performance management and delegation.

  • The ability to influence Product, Engineering and commercial teams through clear reasoning and useful evidence.

  • Comfort building and improving a function in a growing company, while remaining involved in its day-to-day work.

Experience that would be useful

  • Supporting an API platform, developer product or infrastructure business.

  • Working with enterprise customers running important production integrations.

  • Leading support across different time zones.

  • Improving support tooling, knowledge management, self-service or automation.

  • Experience in travel technology, payments or another industry with complex external dependencies.

You don’t need to have worked in travel or held this exact title. We’re interested in the teams you’ve developed, the problems you’ve solved and the judgement you bring.

What success looks like

During your first six months:

  • Engineers have clear expectations, regular coaching and practical development plans.

  • Customer issues have clear ownership, appropriate prioritisation and dependable communication.

  • You have established a trustworthy baseline for support performance and delivered measurable improvements in the most important areas.

  • Escalations reach the right teams with better evidence and fewer unnecessary handovers.

  • Recurring problems are being addressed through product changes, documentation or tooling.

  • Duffel has a clear plan for the support capacity and capabilities needed as the business grows.

Why Join Duffel?

We’re a growth-focused team that values open communication, diverse perspectives, and true ownership. We want you to feel empowered in your role, which is why every permanent employee becomes a company shareholder.

 

🌍 Live Your Best Life

  • Duffel Travel Allowance: We subsidise your wanderlust.

  • Work From Anywhere (60 days): Your office, your rules.

  • Sabbaticals: Long-term loyalty, long-term breaks.

  • Flexible Bank Holidays: Swap holidays to suit your schedule.

🔋 Level Up & Give Back

  • Study Days: Get paid to learn.

  • Volunteering Day: One day a year to save the world.

  • Electric Car & Cycle Schemes: Eco-friendly rides, tax-free prices.

🛡️ The Essentials, Upgraded

  • Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption): Big support for life’s biggest moments, 26 weeks fully paid.

  • Pensions & Loans: Future-proofing and interest-free commuting.

  • Eye Tests: Keeping your vision (and your style) sharp.

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.

You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.

You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes.

  • Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows.

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale - powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

Location: London, UK | Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent | Reports to: Chief Customer Officer

We're looking for a Head of Security Operations to build Radiant's security function from the ground up. This is a founding role where you’ll help to define the strategy, tooling and operating model for security across our data centres, compute platform and network fabric.

You will also represent Radiant's security posture directly to customers and prospects who are evaluating us for their AI workloads. You will work closely with our Commercial, Compliance and Engineering teams, coordinating on shared risk reporting, security testing and audit evidence.

What You'll Do

Security Strategy & Leadership:

  • Build and own Radiant's security strategy from the ground up, including policy, standards and risk posture for customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Develop our security practices, governance, risk and reporting

  • Define the roadmap and maturity targets for the function.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!


About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience.

First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience.

And we mean accountancy specifically. Experience partnering with Finance, managing a People budget or processing payroll isn't the same thing.

Why such a specific combination? Because we've seen first-hand just how well it can work.

We've seen the value that a professional accountancy background can bring when combined with strong People Operations experience - financial discipline, an instinct for controls and data, and an analytical approach to understanding how systems and processes work. We're now deliberately looking for that combination again.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You'll want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

What does that mean in practice?

  • You're naturally curious and analytical. You ask good questions, get underneath problems and use data rather than instinct alone to make decisions.

  • You love improving how things work. You've reviewed, redesigned and implemented processes rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and a confident collaborator. You can turn an idea into something that actually works and bring people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Previous professional experience working as an accountant or in a substantive accountancy role. This is essential for this particular hire.

  • Significant People Operations experience, with evidence that you've owned and designed end-to-end People processes, not simply operated processes someone else created.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data using a modern tech stack, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're of course open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems, alongside strong analytical and advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including ownership of pay review cycles, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement - spotting friction, getting underneath the root cause and leading meaningful changes that have made processes simpler, better or more scalable.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate. You'll be comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working.

  • You'll be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech to solve problems and make change happen.

It would also be great if you have

  • Experience working in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

And one thing you won't need

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

A little more about the contract

This is initially a three-month fixed-term contract. We're continuing to think about the longer-term shape of our People team, so there is the potential for the role to become permanent if there's a strong mutual fit and an ongoing need.

We're also open to part-time working for the right person. Finding the right combination of People Operations and professional accountancy experience matters more to us than insisting on a particular working pattern.

Orbital's London office isn't just a place to sit - it's where culture comes to life, where collaboration gets real, and where the best version of our company shows up every day. We need someone to own that.

As Workplace Experience Manager, you'll be the person who makes in-person time feel intentional, energising, and genuinely worth showing up for. You'll spot what needs improving before anyone else does, elevate what's already good into something exceptional, and care deeply about the details that most people never notice - but everyone feels.

This isn't a head-down admin role, and it's not a purely strategic one either. We want someone who can define what "great" looks like and then go make it happen - someone equally at home rethinking the summer party concept and making sure the snacks never run out.

You'll report into our Head of Operations and be based in our London office five days a week.

What You'll Do

Elevate the Workplace Experience

Our office should feel like the best version of Orbital - energising, considered, and somewhere people genuinely want to be. You'll own that. Not by waiting for someone to point out a problem, but by constantly asking what would make this better - and then making it happen.

You will:

  • Assess what’s working and what isn’t, and proactively improve it

  • Refine layout, flow, rituals, and small details that shift perception

  • Raise standards without being asked

You’ll play a central role in shaping our new London office and ensuring the space supports how we work.

Deliver events and rituals that matter

From Wednesday lunches to the summer party, from All Hands to company off-sites - every in-person moment is a chance to reinforce culture, build real connection, and make people feel good about where they work. You'll own the events calendar end-to-end and make sure every event is considered, well-executed, and genuinely worth people's time.

You will:

  • Develop clear concepts and briefs

  • Manage vendors and budgets confidently

  • Create simple communication plans to drive attendance and engagement

  • Design lightweight feedback loops, analyse results, and continuously improve

Great workplace experience starts with a workplace that just works. Snacks stocked. Meeting rooms set up. Vendors sorted. You'll build the systems and habits that keep the fundamentals running so smoothly that nobody has to think about them - because you already have.

You will own:

  • The overall standards and day-to-day functioning of the office environment

  • Vendor relationships, facilities coordination, and office supplies

  • Organising weekly lunches and keeping snacks stocked

  • Health & safety essentials

  • AV and meeting room setup (calls work, screens connect, rooms are ready)

  • Desk booking software: managing the platform and ensuring it reflects real attendance patterns

  • Meeting room scheduling and utilisation: preventing friction and resolving booking issues

You’ll proactively monitor how the office operates, spotting and resolving issues before they surface.

Own the first impression

Whether it's a candidate walking in for their first interview or a new joiner arriving on day one, you're often the first face of Orbital people meet in person. That moment matters more than most people realise. You'll make sure it's warm, considered, and sets exactly the right tone.

Working closely with the People and Talent teams, you will:

  • Ensure interview days run smoothly, including preparing rooms and coordinating logistics

  • Be the welcoming face for candidates on interview days, stepping in as the on-site host when the Talent team aren't available

  • Send welcome emails to new joiners ahead of their start date and add them to the new starter programme calendar

  • Arrange travel for new joiners who are onboarding at another Orbital office

  • Meet new joiners on their first day and lead the office induction alongside IT

  • Act as the primary office point of contact throughout the onboarding period

  • Reinforce and strengthen our employer brand through every in-person interaction with candidates and new joiners

A brilliant office initiative that nobody knows about isn't brilliant. You'll make sure people are informed, excited, and showing up - by communicating clearly, consistently, and with real personality.

You will:

As part of the wider Back Office ecosystem, you’ll support operational processes where workplace and wider operations intersect.

  • Standardising the global office experience: Working alongside our US Office Lead to ensure that everyone at Orbital has a great office experience, regardless of where they are based.

  • High standards, discretion and strong attention to detail

  • Strong operational reliability: you create systems so basics don’t break

  • Proactive ownership: you don’t wait for detailed briefs

  • Background in hospitality or events

Why this might not be for you

  • You prefer steady rhythms or high predictability. There will be weeks where an event or a project requires extra effort. We don't expect it constantly, but flexibility matters.

  • You're not comfortable being in the office most days. This is an in-office role.

  • Large, established companies are more your speed. We're a growing Series B company. Things change, processes are still being built, and comfort with ambiguity is essential.

  • Details don't excite you. The gap between a good workplace and a great one lives in the small things. If you're not someone who cares whether each meeting has a room that works for their agenda or an event feels thoughtful, this won't bring out your best work.

Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

raw.description:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.

Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.

📐 About this role

This is a chance to help shape the next chapter of WRITER's product at a moment when generative AI is redefining how work gets done. As senior staff product manager, you'll report directly to Wil Pong, VP of Product, and operate as a force-multiplier across the product organization — setting direction where it's unclear, aligning stakeholders, and making sure our most critical initiatives ship with excellence.

You'll own ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces that span multiple product areas and teams, and you'll be equal parts strategist and operator. One moment you're shaping a multi-quarter roadmap; the next you're rolling up your sleeves to unblock execution. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer empathy, technical depth, and business judgment — and who is energized by turning complex, evolving AI capabilities into products customers love.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Your responsibilities

  • Drive high-impact product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and problem definition through launch, adoption, and iteration across areas that span multiple squads and surfaces

  • Shape product strategy and roadmap in partnership with the VP of Product and product leadership, translating company-level goals into clear, sequenced, ambitious bets

  • Spend time with enterprise buyers, end users, and prospects to uncover unmet needs, validate problem-solution fit, and champion the customer voice in every decision

  • Partner closely with engineering and design to define requirements, navigate technical tradeoffs, and build the right things in the right order, bringing real fluency to conversations about LLMs, agents, platform architecture, and data

  • Align cross-functional stakeholders across go-to-market, sales, marketing, customer success, and executive leadership, communicating strategy and tradeoffs with crisp, audience-appropriate narrative

  • Define and own success metrics for your areas, using data and qualitative signal to evaluate impact, course-correct, and tell the story of outcomes to leadership

  • Raise the bar on product craft across the org by mentoring and coaching other PMs, modeling best practices, and strengthening a culture built on rigor, customer obsession, and velocity

⭐️ Is this you?

  • 8+ years of product management experience with a track record of owning and shipping complex, high-impact products, ideally in SaaS, platform, infrastructure, or AI/ML-driven environments

  • Senior- or staff-level experience operating autonomously across ambiguous, multi-team problem spaces and influencing outcomes well beyond your immediate team

  • Genuine customer obsession — you instinctively go to the customer, synthesize signal from noise, and design from a deep understanding of real workflows and pain points

  • Technical credibility to engage meaningfully with engineers and researchers on system design, LLM capabilities, data, and architecture, knowing when to go deep and when to defer to the experts

  • A blend of strong strategic thinking and relentless execution — you can set a compelling vision one moment and sweat the details of a release plan the next

  • Exceptional communication that you tailor for any audience, from a frontline engineer to the executive team, driving alignment without relying on org chart authority

  • A mentor's instinct and a builder's drive, with the data-informed, outcome-driven mindset to define success up front and move with the speed this environment demands

Nice to haves

  • Experience building products powered by LLMs, generative AI, or large-scale AI/ML systems

  • Background in enterprise software, developer platforms, or developer-facing products

  • Familiarity with AI governance, guardrails, and the operational considerations of deploying AI in regulated or high-stakes environments

  • Generous PTO, plus company holidays

  • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

  • Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

  • Fertility and family planning support

  • Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri

  • Competitive pension scheme and company contribution

  • Annual work-life stipends for:

    • Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

    • Learning and development stipend

  • Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites
